==Bundles==

==Recipes==
Malachite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Malachite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Green Belted Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt189.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
